# GEO report: atlas-roadmaps **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 57/100, Needs work Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 13.08 ÷ 23 × 100 = 57. High = (13.08 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 57. This is a Remix app (it renders pages on the server) with a declared policy to allow AI search crawlers and block training crawlers. The biggest loss is `robots.txt` shutting out Bing. That one line loses points on two rules. Nothing was left unknown. The score comes from reading the code, not from a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Bingbot - **Why it matters:** Bingbot is Microsoft's search crawler. Blocking it site-wide contradicts your own "allow AI search" policy and makes every page unindexable for Bing. It loses points on both GEO-009 and GEO-014. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Bingbot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 83 (19.08 ÷ 23) ### 2. Add a `Sitemap:` line to robots.txt - **Why it matters:** Your sitemap exists but nothing points crawlers to it, so it can't be discovered. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt` (end of file; no `Sitemap:` line exists) - **What the code says:** the file ends with `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: GPTBot` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 66 (15.08 ÷ 23). Add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`. ### 3. Load the changelog on the server - **Why it matters:** The entries are fetched in the browser, so the server HTML is an empty list. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see no changelog. - **Where:** `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5` - **What the code says:** `useEffect(() => { fetch('/api/changelog').then((r) => r.json()).then(setEntries); }, []);` - **Size:** Medium (use a Remix `loader`) - **Score after this:** 60 (13.83 ÷ 23) ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt valid and reachable | Clear | `public/robots.txt`, valid lines, tiny | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers get the access your policy says | Problem | `public/robots.txt:5` Bingbot blocked; GPTBot block (line 8) is a training-crawler choice and isn't counted | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | All 4 routes blocked for Bingbot (`robots.txt:5`). No `noindex` on public routes. `/dashboard` noindex is deliberate | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own domain | Problem | 3 of 4 routes clear; `/pricing` has none (`app/routes/pricing.tsx:1`) | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Problem | 3 of 4 clear; `/changelog` fetches in `useEffect` (`changelog.tsx:5`) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Problem | `public/sitemap.xml` is valid, but `robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Clear | `root.tsx:5` has `lang="en"`; all 4 routes get a title and description (`/pricing` inherits the root default) | | GEO-016 | Routes reachable by real links | Problem | 2 of 3 clear; `/features` only via `onClick` (`_index.tsx:9`) | | GEO-017 | No snippet blocking | Clear | No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet:0` found in the app code | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | Read `root.tsx` and all routes; no images, nav links have text | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | No mobile app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not scored; no `llms.txt` present | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not scored | ## Other problems found - **Main CTA isn't a link:** `app/routes/_index.tsx:9`: `
navigate('/features')}>See all features
`. Use `` so crawlers and keyboard users can follow it. The same fix covers GEO-016. - **Features page missing from the nav:** `app/routes/../root.tsx:7`: `
Pricing Changelog
`. Add `Features` here, so every page links to it in server HTML. ## Worth considering - **Pricing page has no prices:** `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1`: `Plans that grow with your team. Talk to us for a quote.` A visitor comes here to learn cost and plan differences. Listing plan names, prices and what's included might help readers and machines. - **Pricing has its own title and description missing:** `pricing.tsx:1` has no `meta` export, so it uses the root `Atlas` / `Roadmaps your whole team can follow.` Add a specific title and description, plus the canonical `https://atlasroadmaps.example/pricing`. - **Unbacked claim on the home page:** `_index.tsx:8`: `Integrates with all the tools you already use.` Name the integrations in text (and perhaps give them their own pages). - **Features page is thin:** `features.tsx:1`: `Timelines, sharing and status updates.` Each feature could get a short section, and the page promises more than it shows. - **Sitemap has no ``:** `public/sitemap.xml:3`: `https://atlasroadmaps.example/`. Add dates, especially for `/changelog`, where real release dates exist. - **Site identity isn't machine-readable:** no Organization or WebSite JSON-LD in `root.tsx`. Adding the name `Atlas` and the origin from `geo.config.json` could help machines identify the site. - **Hand-kept sitemap:** `public/sitemap.xml` is static, so new routes must be added by hand. A Remix resource route could generate it. - **Head basics missing:** `root.tsx:6` renders `` with no `charset`, `viewport` or social tags (`og:title` and so on). - **Changelog entries could have their own pages:** `changelog.tsx:6`: `{entries.map((e) =>
  • {e}
    • )}`. Each release with its own URL could be linked and cited individually. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live-only checks:** real status codes, redirects, `X-Robots-Tag` headers, whether sitemap URLs answer 200, and whether `/api/changelog` returns data. These don't change the code results. ## Assumptions - Remix runs with server rendering, since no SPA or prerender config exists. I didn't read `entry.server.tsx` (not in the repo). - GEO-014 counts the Bingbot block as making routes non-indexable, per the rule. It overlaps with GEO-009. - `/dashboard` is private on purpose: noindex plus a `robots.txt` disallow, and it's not in the sitemap. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
